goal: Add a canonical Postgres-dialect persistence schema at docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql mirroring docs/persistence-schema.sql with JSONB, TIMESTAMPTZ, BIGSERIAL, BOOLEAN types, foreign keys, and append-only triggers on grader_results.

references: docs/persistence-schema.sql -- mirror table set, column semantics, and header comments in the Postgres dialect
constraints: All DDL uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS / CREATE TRIGGER ... IF NOT EXISTS (or DO $$ guard) for idempotent bootstrap.
Tables required: lifecycles, attempts, events, grader_results, claude_session_store.
*_json columns use JSONB; timestamp columns use TIMESTAMPTZ; autoincrement ids use BIGSERIAL; grader_results.passed is BOOLEAN.
Foreign keys mirror the SQLite file: attempts(run_id) -> lifecycles(run_id); events(run_id) -> lifecycles(run_id); grader_results(run_id, attempt_number) -> attempts(run_id, number).
Append-only enforcement on grader_results via BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers raising a clear exception.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'feat:' or 'docs:') before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not implement PostgresStore in this task.
Do not add migration tooling (Alembic etc.).
edge_cases: Schema-name substitution mechanics (placeholder vs. SET search_path) are the implementer's call later; this file may use unqualified names or a documented ${schema} placeholder convention.
Header comment should call out that grader_results is append-only and that the table is enforced via triggers, mirroring the SQLite file.

graders.run: grep -q JSONB docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql && grep -q TIMESTAMPTZ docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql && grep -q BIGSERIAL docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql && grep -q BOOLEAN docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql
graders.name: types

graders.run: for t in lifecycles attempts events grader_results claude_session_store; do grep -qE "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS [\"a-zA-Z_.\${}]*$t" docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql || { echo missing $t; exit 1; }; done
graders.name: tables

graders.run: grep -qE 'BEFORE UPDATE ON ["a-zA-Z_.\${}]*grader_results' docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql && grep -qE 'BEFORE DELETE ON ["a-zA-Z_.\${}]*grader_results' docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql
graders.name: append-only-triggers

graders.run: grep -q REFERENCES docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql && grep -qE 'FOREIGN KEY.*run_id.*REFERENCES.*lifecycles' docs/persistence-schema-postgres.sql
graders.name: foreign-keys
